title: Killer Bee content schema for Nostr kind 30178 (team catalog projection)
description: The parsed `content` body of a kind:30178 event as PUBLISHED BY KILLER BEE. Upstream deliberately leaves this open — 'The content schema is defined by the client that publishes it' (buzz docs/nips/NIP-AP.md:223 @ ed4b3e7a) — and the only body the upstream's own tests bless is {"v":1,"name":...,"members":[]} with members always empty (e2e_team_catalog.rs:35, ingest.rs:4111). This schema is that shape with the member projection defined: each member is the buzz-agent-snapshot the Killer Bee emitter produces, minus the fields NIP-AP.md:242 orders sanitized (no respond_to allowlist pubkeys — and respondTo goes with it, since the enum without its list asserts a policy a reader cannot reconstruct; env vars, paths and local ids were never emitted). Everything else keeps the snapshot shape ON PURPOSE: write a member as a .agent.json file and the Buzz desktop imports it without translation — every field the import parse requires is present, and the stripped ones carry serde defaults upstream. Envelope rules (d tag, shared tag, 256 KiB) are the relay's, not this schema's.

members.description: Ordered, embedded member projections — the order is the team's order.

systemPrompt.description: The full prompt, verbatim. Sharing a team makes every member's instructions community-readable plaintext — NIP-AP says so and so do we.

memory.description: A catalog projection carries nobody's memory: level is 'none' and entries stay empty, always.
